tools.name: spotify
tools.description: Controls the user's Spotify playback. Use when the user asks to play, pause, skip, change volume, or asks what is playing. "play" with a query searches for a track; "playlist" searches a playlist (good for moods like "lofi focus" or "deep work"). "setup" saves the Client ID given as query; "login" opens the browser to connect the account.
